title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 909 West Holiday Drive in Fate, Texas, as the "Ralph Hall Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 909 West Holiday Drive in Fate, Texas, as the "Ralph Hall Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named the post office at 909 West Holiday Drive in Fate, Texas, after former Congressman Ralph Hall.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility in Fate, Texas, as the "Ralph Hall Post Office." It is a symbolic honor and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, postal rules, and staffing stay the same.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 30, 2020.
